subject: Implement session-control slash commands (/new, /status, /clear, /kill, /override)
description:
In `capo/transport/dispatcher.py`, add a pre-agent slash-command parser per §5.10. Commands consume ZERO tokens (no agent call) and return their action result via `amc.send`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `/new` — End current session (set `sessions.ended_at = NOW()`), start a new one. In-memory history reference cleared; older history retained on disk.
- [ ] `/status` — Reply with current session info: messages, approximate token count, running delegations.
- [ ] `/clear` — Same as `/new` but also marks the session's history as compacted-out (a single "cleared by user" marker remains in `conversation_history`).
- [ ] `/kill <delegation_id>` — Initiates `kill_delegation` (which triggers approval per Phase 4).
- [ ] `/approve <id>` and `/deny <id>` — already wired in Phase 4.
- [ ] `/override` — already wired by budget hook in this phase.
- [ ] All slash commands consume ZERO tokens (no `agent.run`).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Unknown slash command: replied with a list of valid commands.
- [ ] Slash command at start of message but with trailing text: ignore trailing text.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: parser matches every command + arg form
• Integration: `/status` reflects accurate live state
• Integration: `/new` creates a new active session row and ends the prior one

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.10, 9.5
